# Local animation libraries

`gsap.min.js` and `ScrollTrigger.min.js` are the GSAP 3.15.0 distribution files from the `gsap` npm package, with trailing whitespace normalized. They are served from this site, with no third-party script request or runtime package install. Their copyright and license links are preserved in each file's header.

GSAP license: https://gsap.com/standard-license/

To update, install the desired GSAP npm version, copy these two files from its `dist/` directory, and run the site motion/accessibility checks.
